hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | grep -Eq '\bgit\b.*\b(add|commit)\b' && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"git add and git commit are blocked from automated use in this project per CLAUDE.md -- run them yourself in the terminal."}}' || true
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.py) uv run black "$f" && uv run isort "$f" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
